notes: «قالوا حدثنا عوف» converges three co-transmitters on Awf; the chain is one route, so it is one group with no tail.
«هو ابن أبي جميلة» is an editor gloss on Awf and is left out.
The Prophet is the end of the chain; the compiler's remarks on the other route (Ayyub from Abu Raja from Ibn Abbas) are not written as routes here.
